Package index

ICF semantics & goals

icf_catalog()
ICF catalogue (stroke gait core-set subset)
icf_qualifier_label()
Label an ICF qualifier (0-4 severity)
icf_change()
ICF qualifier change across an episode (improvement = qualifier decreases)
icf_for_measure()
Map a measure to ICF codes via the real ontology (PhysioAnnotationHub)
rehab_goal()
Define a rehabilitation goal (ICF-linked, GAS-scaled)

Single-case episode & analysis

new_rehab_episode()
Create an empty rehabilitation episode (single-case)
add_session()
Record one therapy session
sced_analyze()
Analyse an episode's primary measure with SCED + MCID (via PhysioAppKit)

Reasoning, report & plot

rehab_hypothesis()
State a clinical hypothesis about expected change
evaluate_hypothesis()
Evaluate a hypothesis against the episode's evidence
draft_progress_note()
Draft an ICF-structured progress note from an analysed episode
plot_trajectory()
Plot a single-case trajectory with phase line, 2-SD band and MCID target

Guided workflow & GUI

rehab_workflow()
Run the full single-case rehab workflow (guided, one call)
rehab_app()
Build the PhysioRehab clinician prototype GUI
launch_rehab_app()
Launch the PhysioRehab GUI in a browser

Real-signal adapters

mocap_gait_measures()
Real gait/kinematic measures from an OpenPose recording (via PhysioMoCap)
add_session_from_mocap()
Append a rehab session whose measures come from a real OpenPose recording
emg_fatigue_measures()
Real muscle-fatigue / amplitude measures from an EMG recording (via PhysioEMG)
add_session_from_emg()
Append a rehab session whose measures come from a real EMG recording

Example data

simulate_stroke_gait_case()
Simulate a stroke hemiplegic-gait single-case episode
